newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sam Yang sets bonus, rights issues.
newsitem.headline: Sam Yang sets bonus, rights issues.

text.p: South Korea's Sam Yang Heavy Machinery Co Ltd said on Thursday it was offering a 24-for-100 rights issue in January at a 25 percent discount.
The company is also offering a one-for-10 bonus issue in January as part of a plan to raise its paid-in capital to 6.18 billion won from the current 4.32 billion won, a company statement said.
The statement said it planned to issue 259,200 common shares, of which 20 percent would be offered to employees. The rest will be allocated as rights to shareholders registered as of December 5.
The base price for the rights shares will be decided later. Subscription is scheduled for January 6 and 7, with payment due by January 22.
Sam Yang will also issue 112,320 common bonus shares to holders of shares on January 23, it said.
Sam Yang's shares traded at 46,500 won in Thursday afternoon trading, up 700 won from Wednesday.
